files.patch:
+ public static string Slugify(string name) => name.ToLowerInvariant().Replace(' ', '-');
+ internal static void PurgeCache() => Cache.Clear();

902.body: Normalize file naming by slugifying with the existing shared helper in `src/Profiles/Slug.cs` so all modes agree. Do not introduce a second slug implementation.

comments.body: Correction: the newest decision is to keep `Slug.Slugify` as the single implementation and delete any local copies. Requirements.md must gain a REQ for naming normalization.
